title: Firmware Spider telemetry event
description: Canonical event schema + taxonomy shared by the Python (fwspider_telemetry) and Node (fwspider-telemetry.mjs) emitters. One JSON object per line in events/*.jsonl.

ts.description: UTC RFC3339 with microseconds and Z suffix

monotonic_ns.description: per-process monotonic clock; compare only within one process_id

seq.description: per-run monotonic sequence allocated under the log-dir lock; unique per run_id across processes and restarts

artifact_id.description: firmware/content artifact (e.g. sha256:<hex>, image id) - not a log artifact

data.description: sanitized payload; values pass the central redaction pipeline

log_artifacts.description: log artifact envelope refs (art_...) referenced by data

applicability.attach.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (applicability/attach); emitted after commit

applicability.check.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (applicability/check); emitted after commit

applicability.check_refused.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (applicability/check_refused); emitted after commit

applicability.decide.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (applicability/decide); emitted after commit

applicability.decision_refused.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (applicability/decision_refused); emitted after commit

applicability.propagate.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (applicability/propagate); emitted after commit

artifact.binary_describe.description: binary/firmware object described by path/size/hashes/type/preview (no raw bytes)

artifact.write.description: bounded artifact envelope stored (sha256, lengths, truncation)

attack_chain.edge.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (attack_chain/edge); emitted after commit

attack_chain.node.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (attack_chain/node); emitted after commit

attack_chain.precondition.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (attack_chain/precondition); emitted after commit

attack_chain.precondition_refused.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (attack_chain/precondition_refused); emitted after commit

attack_chain.reuse.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (attack_chain/reuse); emitted after commit

attack_chain.reuse_refused.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (attack_chain/reuse_refused); emitted after commit

budget.block.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (budget/block); emitted after commit

budget.raise.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (budget/raise); emitted after commit

campaign.create.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (campaign/create); emitted after commit

campaign.stop.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (campaign/stop); emitted after commit

checkpoint.put.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (checkpoint/put); emitted after commit

cli.error.description: CLI command refused/failed; error JSON digest recorded

cli.result.description: CLI command finished; stdout digest/length recorded

closeout.blocked.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (closeout/blocked); emitted after commit

closeout.pass.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (closeout/pass); emitted after commit

disposition.accepted.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (disposition/accepted); emitted after commit

disposition.refused.description: ArcticBase ledger-derived state transition (disposition/refused); emitted after commit

download.file_complete.description: file moved into place and recorded in download-ledger

download.file_quarantine_bad.description: existing file failed verification and was renamed aside

download.snapshot.description: export manifest snapshot written (rows, sha256, path)

error.exception.description: exception with redacted message, stack, cause chain, retry decision, correlation IDs

model.call_end.description: model call closed (status, attempts, total latency/tokens)
